record.question: What is the purpose of assembling medical records?
options: To organize all patient data systematically
record.explanation: Answer C: To organize all patient data systematically. Assembling the record organizes all patient data systematically so it can be reviewed, used, and retrieved. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
